# AxoBoard

> AxoBoard is an operational KPI dashboard and team-performance platform for teams that need trusted metrics, timely notifications, visible recognition, and healthy competition.

## Canonical website

- https://axoboard.io/

## What AxoBoard is

- A customizable, responsive KPI dashboard service for web, mobile, and planned TV displays.
- Designed around visible metric definitions, source context, freshness, goals, comparisons, and governed publishing.
- Differentiated by its roadmap for KPI notifications, branded celebrations and sounds, and configurable Team Competitions.
- Intended for sales, operations, leadership, and multi-location teams that need a shared operating score.

## Product status

- AxoBoard is currently in pre-launch development.
- Google Sheets is the first direct integration in development.
- Shopify, Wix, Microsoft Excel, HubSpot, and Salesforce are on the integration roadmap.
- Public checkout and self-service dashboard activation are not yet available.
- Roadmap features are not represented as generally available until they pass production testing.

## Public pricing hypothesis

- Starter: $99/month or $79/month billed annually.
- Growth: $249/month or $199/month billed annually.
- Scale: $599/month or $499/month billed annually.
- Enterprise: from $1,500/month on an annual contract.
- Every paid plan is designed to include unlimited dashboards and viewers; capacity varies by connections, editors, screens, refresh speed, history, automation, and governance.
